dimensions.assessment: Affects persons, nonprofits, and government entities eligible for EPA grants, as well as communities near contaminated sites.
dimensions.evidence: may provide assistance, including by entering into contracts and cooperative agreements and making awards, to persons, State, local, and Tribal government entities, and nonprofit organizations

dimensions.assessment: Provides targeted grants and technical evaluation for critical material recovery and environmental cleanup.
dimensions.evidence: investigate, evaluate, and support processes, methods, and systems which may be utilized in... the recovery of such critical materials

dimensions.assessment: Caps aggregate assistance at $10 million per fiscal year and individual assistance at $3 million per recipient.
dimensions.evidence: in the aggregate, in an amount that exceeds $10,000,000 in any fiscal year; or... to any person... exceeds $3,000,000

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a new statutory program within the EPA with specific evaluation criteria and award caps.
dimensions.evidence: The Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency shall carry out a program

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a temporary program that terminates 10 years after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: The program under subsection (a) shall terminate on the date that is 10 years after the date of enactment of this section.

missing_information: Total authorized appropriations beyond the annual spending caps
importance_detail.rationale: This bill establishes a 10-year EPA program to investigate and support the recovery of critical materials from contaminated sites, authorizing assistance up to $10 million annually.
